items.title: Experienced Mobile Application Engineer at Scoville
items.summary: Scoville正在招聘一名经验丰富的移动应用工程师，负责使用React Native开发跨平台iOS和Android应用，主要面向日本大学生的社团活动B2C应用。

items.title: Android Software Engineer - AI Finance Agent at Bjak
items.summary: Android Software Engineer role focused on building the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent app using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Position is based in Japan with hybrid work arrangement (3 days/week in office).

items.title: Backend Developer (Kotlin/Java + Spring Boot) - Money Forward
items.summary: Money Forwardが募集する中級レベルのバックエンド開発者。サーバーサイドKotlinとSpring Bootフレームワークを使用して、安全なOIDC認証プラットフォームの構築とスケーリングに取り組む。

items.title: Kotlin Android Engineer (Japan Dev Platform)
items.summary: 日本Dev平台上列出了13个需要Kotlin技能的职位，其中包括Android工程师岗位。这些职位提供签证担保，支持从海外申请，适合有Android开发和Kotlin经验的候选人。

items.title: Senior Software Engineer - Engage Studio at Treasure AI
items.summary: Treasure AI is looking for a Senior Software Engineer for their Engage Studio in Tokyo. While primarily a full-stack role, mobile development experience is listed as a nice-to-have qualification.

items.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer at Visual Alpha
items.summary: Visual Alpha is seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer for their financial AI platform in Tokyo. This role offers visa sponsorship and supports relocation to Japan with partial remote work.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer (Go), API Platform Department at Money Forward
items.summary: Money Forward is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for their API Platform Department in Kyoto. This Go-focused role supports visa sponsorship and relocation to Japan with partial remote work.
